items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: I wonder who it was. Ray Ludwig.

ctx.x: If they weren't good, I wouldn't get any like it. I wouldn't take any of them. Well, I don't know if this is you or not. That's what we're playing it for. No, that's not me.
Well, that's a... I'm sure that's a WGN band. Got cued in there. That's how they sound, see? A lot of people will take that for Bix. I wonder who it was. Ray Ludwig. All day long, I sing a song.
Sing a song, cause nothing's wrong. Nothing's wrong, nothing's wrong. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
